title: Fifth special sitting of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/2025/20/ޚޞ/5).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request to appoint the Chair and Deputy Chair of the Civil Service Commission under Article 17(c) of the Civil Service Act (Law No. 5/2007) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request to appoint the Vice President of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives under Article 8(c) of the Human Rights Commission Act (Law No. 6/2006) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on its review of the Public Referendum Bill (bill on holding public-opinion referendums).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: This special out-of-session sitting sent the President's Civil Service Commission and Human Rights Commission leadership picks to committee and took up the committee report on the Public Referendum Bill.
